title: Add read-only verb bee knowledge search (symptom pull into the bundle)
action: New verb `bee knowledge search` in verbs/knowledge/search.rs, registered in routing.rs try_native and the knowledge group. Grammar mirrors decisions search (per D1): --text required, whitespace-split terms, case-insensitive OR; --limit optional (default 5, per D4); json flag. Corpus: patterns + area concepts of the active bundle only — skip generated index.md/log.md files, never docs/specs/ or decisions (per D2). Match over title, body, and frontmatter sources/decisions entries; rank by deterministic term-hit count desc then file recency desc (per D3). Output rows: path — title — why-matched line naming which terms hit in which field (per D4). Zero hits emits an empty result with a one-line note, exit 0, never a typed refusal (per D5). Verb is read-only, writes:[], callable at any phase from any checkout (per D7). Registry entry (help text + flags) goes through the registry payload's real regen chain — find it first (registry.rs points at `bee dev`); if the chain turns out to be hand-maintained JSON, edit it and keep tests/registry_contracts.rs green, noting the gap in the trace. Tests TDD-style in the knowledge verb test module: rank order determinism, field attribution in why-matched, zero-hit shape, bundle-absent behavior.

truths: `bee knowledge search --text <term>` returns ranked rows with why-matched from a repo with a bundle
zero-hit query exits 0 with empty result note
verb never writes any file or state

artifacts.substantive: full verb implementation with tests, no TODO stubs

key_links: registry payload carries knowledge.search entry so --help and catalog resolve it
prohibitions: No write path, no state mutation
No change to existing knowledge verbs' behavior
